name: Honey Caramel Latte
flavor_notes: A warm, rich latte combining the floral sweetness of honey with creamy caramel, brewed with a double espresso.
barista_note: Warm the mug first so the milk and coffee stay hot to the last sip.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Big Trouble or Joe Coffee The Daily

ingredients.notes: For less caffeine, use Half Caff (~90 mg) or Decaf capsules; same flavor.

steps: In your serving mug, combine 1.5 tbsp Honey.
Melt 2 Cometeer capsules (about 5 minutes submerged in hot water, or overnight in the fridge). Pour it into the mug over the syrups and spices; stir until fully dissolved.
Warm and froth milk to about 140°F (60°C). Pour the frothed milk over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon the velvety foam on top.
Finish with a dusting of Caramel Sauce.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
steps: Froth milk until suitable for a latte.
Pour the steamed milk into the mug with the honey and stir to combine.
Brew the coffee directly into the mug.
Finish with a swirl of caramel sauce on top.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Nescafé Gold Espresso or Mount Hagen Organic
steps: In your serving mug, combine 1.5 tbsp Honey.
Dissolve 4 tsp instant espresso in 4 oz (120 ml) hot water directly in the mug over the syrups and spices; stir until completely dissolved.
Warm and froth milk to about 140°F (60°C). Pour the frothed milk over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon the velvety foam on top.
Finish with a dusting of Caramel Sauce.
